dedupe_keys.name: hkcert statistics on security incidents reported monthly counts by incident type hong kong

description: HKCERT, Hong Kong's computer emergency response team, publishes the number of security incidents reported to it each month, broken down by type of incident such as phishing, botnets, malware and ransomware, hacking and website defacement. Its statistics page presents interactive charts of the monthly figures by type to show the cyber threat landscape of Hong Kong, and the same monthly series is published on the government open data portal as JSON files in English, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese. Coverage: incidents reported to HKCERT by the public, organisations and partner teams in Hong Kong. Format and access: JSON files and web charts, free under the DATA.GOV.HK terms with attribution. Caveats: reported incidents only, influenced by awareness and reporting channels, and the categories may change over time; the incident types listed here are from recall. Simulation uses: frequency of cyber incidents as input to threat and failure scenarios for digital services, and trends for stress testing. Related records: the CERT.br incident statistics for Brazil and the BACS cyber incident statistics for Switzerland are comparable national series.
